title: Two models refine the same view differently; each sees only its own refinement
rule: A refinement applies only to the models whose includes reach the refining file.

citations.quote: In your model file, include the files where your refinements are defined.
Use the include parameter in a model file to specify the dashboard and view files that will be available to that model.

rationale: Each model includes a different refinement file. A file a model does not include is not available to that model, so its refinement cannot apply there.
